title: Clinton ends the Superconducting Super Collider

tellings.quote: On October 30th, 1993, President Clinton signed into law the death blow to the superconducting super collider.

plain: On October 30, 1993, President Bill Clinton signed the law that killed the Superconducting Super Collider, a huge planned particle-smashing machine for physics research in the United States. The mathematician and commentator Eric Weinstein tells this without naming a source. He tells it as the moment American big physics was cut off.
